answer: Declarations are reconciled in vine, as a result the operator census is checkable by anyone, and prism publishes it each epoch. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 10 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a kernel record. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
